events-note: These are parsed events, not tactical judgements. Timecodes are absolute demo time, not video clips.
explain-combat: Verified combat outcomes, including eliminations and their recorded match context.
explain-context: Match-context modifiers and model centering. A negative value may come from centering, not a bad action.
explain-cross-family: Applied jointly across negative families; not assigned to individual events.
explain-death-related: Recorded death exposure. A death is a fact, not an automatic tactical mistake.
explain-direct-harm: Verified harm to teammates, softened before the active H2 influence is applied.
explain-final-family-only: Final influence is available only at family level.
explain-objectives: Verified bomb or hostage objective actions, with model limits applied when needed.
explain-support: Verified assists, flashes and other recorded support for teammates.
explain-transform-context-center: Context centering against the model baseline
explain-transform-negative: Shared nonlinear normalization of negative families
important-fast-trade-summary: Eliminated the opponent {{seconds}} seconds after a teammate died.
important-moments-note: Only verified multi-kills and trades are shown. Ordinary kills, damage and unconfirmed mistakes are excluded.
important-trade-summary: Eliminated the opponent who killed a teammate.
insight-no-weakness: No contextual weakness identified in the supplied analysis.
insight-trades: Keep a teammate in trading distance on entry attempts.
loss-context: Explore this player’s part in the result, including their positive contributions. Defeat alone does not establish blame.
no-events: No recorded events match this selection.
no-important-moments: No verified multi-kills or trades were found for this player.
not-found: This player is not in this match.
rating-absent: Player was absent for too many verified rounds.
rating-explanation-note: Confirmed events explain only the evidence that can be linked safely. Baselines and nonlinear transformations remain separate and are not redistributed across events.
rating-exposure-insufficient: There is not enough verified exposure.
rating-noncausal: This uncalibrated participation score is not proof of tactical blame or intent. Direct harm is only one family, not a verdict.
strengths-unavailable: Personal strengths and weaknesses require contextual analysis. No conclusions are inferred from K/D/A.
unknown-context: The match outcome is unconfirmed. Available actions are shown without a result-based rating.
win-context: Explore this player’s contribution to the win, alongside the actions that could be improved.
